messages.subject: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RcppArmadillo/index.html
parts:
Hi,

This is cool! I am curious if you are going to support Rcpp Armadillo? 
I can run my application great on my computer. However, when I upload it to the cloud It doesn't work.
It says check out the Javascript errors:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:46600
g++: internal compiler error: Killed (program cc1plus)
Please submit a full bug report,
with preprocessed source if appropriate.
See <file:///usr/share/doc/gcc-4.6/README.Bugs> for instructions.
make: *** [Crab_play_model.o] Error 4
Error in sourceCpp("cpp/Crab_play_model.cpp") : 
  Error 1 occurred building shared library.

I don't know how to interpret it; if it was an error my Rcpp code it shouldn't compile and run in plain shiny. 
I wish I knew what I could include in this message to help make shinyapps.io a better success!
Thank you,

Aaron

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RcppArmadillo/index.html
parts:
Aaron,

I think the problem is you're running out of memory compiling your C++ code at runtime.

I would suggest increasing your instance size:


shinyapps::configureApp("your app name", size="medium")

Let me know if that helps.

-Andy
